messages:
Sam Jacobs: Heads-up — Mosaic just flagged a couple signals that look like an account expansion + some potential churn risk. They spun up two new squads (UX and CX) and started a batch of embedding jobs this morning, qps jumped ~6x.
Priya Nair: Nice, do we have details on the embed job shapes? seq len / concurrency?
Sam Jacobs: Sent the request id in the support ticket but quick summary: lots of short docs (avg 300 tokens) with concurrent bulk requests from a webhook consumer. Peak qps ~420 for ~15m window.
Kai Wong: 420 qps short requests on hosted could start to hit soft limits depending on model. Which models are they using?
Sam Jacobs: They're on rdx-small-embed v1 (hosted). Also testing rdx-gen-3 for a personalization feature that might go live next month.
Marisol Rivera: Renewal for Mosaic is in 3 months — CFO asked about unit costs yesterday. This ramp without a committed plan could spike their bill and create friction.
Priya Nair: OK we should propose a Dedicated pilot + recommended batching/caching settings. Kai, can eng validate if we have spare capacity in dedicated pool for a small pilot next week?
Kai Wong: I'll check capacity. Can we ask them to throttle to 250 qps while we spin up a pilot? Also recommend `batch_max_tokens: 2048` and enable prefix caching for short docs.
Sam Jacobs: I've DM'd the Mosaic PM to propose those knobs. They asked for an enablement session — can someone run a 30m co-planning next Tue 11am PT?
Marisol Rivera: I can run the enablement and cover billing + rollout plan. I'll need a short slide deck with cost comparison: hosted vs dedicated vs quantized private. Priya, can you help compile?
Priya Nair: Yep, I'll draft a one-pager. Also capture feedback items: better cost estimator per-route and clearer docs on embedding bulk best practices.
Kai Wong: Eng ask: if they go to dedicated we'll need a canary deploy path and a fallback policy back to hosted if throughput fluctuates. I'll add a quick playbook for ops.
eng-oncall-bot: Notice: recent autoscaler logs show burst allocations at 2023-11-28T14:03:20Z — 3x nodes added for 12m window. No SLA incidents.
Sam Jacobs: Great context, thanks. Action items: 1) Kai — capacity check + ops playbook (due Fri). 2) Priya — one-pager + cost slides (due Mon). 3) Marisol — schedule and run enablement (Tue 11am PT). 4) Sam — confirm throttle + pilot proposal with Mosaic PM (today).
Marisol Rivera: I'll schedule the calendar invite and include eng and product. Sam, please paste the support ticket id in the thread so we can link to logs.
Sam Jacobs: Ticket 89421 — pasted. Also asked Mosaic for a small sample of payloads so eng can run perf tests. They said they'll share by EOD.
Priya Nair: I'll add a note to the renewal tracker that this is a high-opportunity account but invoice shock is a risk. We should offer a committed monthly bundle with a delivered cost estimate.
Sam Jacobs: Thanks team — will post updates here as they come in. :thumbsup:
